summary.text: Maya is a new act aimed at fans of Joanna Sternberg—an introspective, empathetic audience drawn to confessional indie folk. This route connects five Northeastern cities, each near a Qloo fan hotspot.

theme.text: Memory and Refraction: Build the show around intimate storytelling, projected personal archive or found memories, echoing the confessional and reflective core of the audience.
Low-Key Authenticity: A stripped-down, honest set in subdued lighting—emphasizing introspective lyrics and the unvarnished connection fans prize.
Intersection of Analog and Digital: Stage design exploring technology and society themes—vintage instruments or media collage—reflecting the audience's interest in how we live online and offline.

merch.text: Archive Zines: Curated personal or band ephemera—photo essays, lyrics, reflections—honoring the memory and introspection fans value.
Cassette Releases or Limited Vinyl: Physical media appeals to this audience's tangible, low-key sensibility and their interest in how technology shapes how we experience music.

Branded Vintage-Style Apparel: Collaborations or designs inspired by the contemporary fashion brands fans favour (Collina Strada, Rachel Comey, Sandy Liang)—honoring their aesthetic without diluting the intimate brand.

risks.text: Maya has no Qloo data of its own. This plan rests on fans of Joanna Sternberg alone; actual audience response will depend on how closely Maya resonates with those listeners and how effectively the tour is marketed.

Route sequencing may conflict with headliners' touring calendars or regional festival/touring patterns. Dates and venue availability should be confirmed early; the order and timing will require negotiation with support-slot artists and their teams.
